title: What the Dispensing Pharmacy's Standing Adds on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Held Fill
content:
What the standing of the pharmacy dispensing a held fill on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan adds is a difference between two figures of the plan held.

1. Where the dispensing pharmacy carries standard cost sharing and the fill sits on the preferred brand tier, what is added is the difference between the plan's standard retail preferred brand figure and its preferred brand figure.
2. Where the dispensing pharmacy carries standard cost sharing and the fill sits on the preferred generic tier, what is added is the difference between the plan's standard retail preferred generic figure and its preferred generic figure.
3. Where neither holds, nothing is added for the dispensing pharmacy's standing.

| Plan | Standard retail preferred brand figure (USD) | Preferred brand figure (USD) | Added on a preferred brand fill (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 54.0 | 47.0 | 7.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 51.0 | 44.0 | 7.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 49.0 | 42.0 | 7.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 47.0 | 40.0 | 7.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 44.0 | 37.0 | 7.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 40.0 | 33.0 | 7.0 |

| Plan | Standard retail preferred generic figure (USD) | Preferred generic figure (USD) | Added on a preferred generic fill (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 12.0 | 0.0 | 12.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 10.0 | 0.0 | 10.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 9.0 | 1.0 | 8.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 8.0 | 2.0 | 6.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 6.0 | 0.0 | 6.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 5.0 | 0.0 | 5.0 |

Both parts of each of the first two rules must hold together. A fill dispensed by a pharmacy carrying preferred cost sharing has nothing added whatever tier it sits on; a fill at a pharmacy carrying standard cost sharing but sitting on the generic, non-preferred, specialty or select care tiers likewise has nothing added.
